questions.question: In the ninth year of King Hoshea of Israel, what happened to the city of Samaria?

answers.text: The king of Assyria captured it

questions.question: When the king of Assyria invaded Israel and reached Samaria, what did he do to the city?

answers.text: Passed it by on his way to Egypt

questions.question: When Israel abandoned the LORD's commandments, what did they make for themselves besides an Asherah pole?

answers.text: A bronze serpent on a pole

questions.question: After King Jeroboam led Israel into sin, the Israelites finally turned away from the sins he committed. True or false?
